description:
**Vista Plus Administrator – Linux / Oracle (Banking domain)**

**Experience:** 5–7 Years  
**Level:** P3  
**Location:** Hyderabad/Bangalore/pune  
**Support:** 24x7 Rotational Support

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a **Vista Plus Administrator(Banking domain)** with hands-on experience in **Vista Plus Server, Vista Plus Administration Client, Web View, Linux and Oracle/database environments**. The role will be responsible for Vista Plus administration, upgrades, production support, troubleshooting, health monitoring and operational activities.

**Mandatory Skills**

* **Vista Plus Administration**
* Vista Plus Server
* Vista Plus Administration Client
* Vista Plus Web View
* **Linux / Unix Administration**
* Application installation and upgrades
* Shell scripting
* File system management
* Oracle / Database concepts
* SQL
* Production Support
* Application health-check monitoring
* Incident, Change & Problem Management
* ITIL processes

**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer and support **Vista Plus Server and related components**.
* Perform Vista Plus **installation, configuration, upgrades and new releases**.
* Troubleshoot Vista Plus Server, Administration Client and Web Client issues.
* Monitor application health and production environments.
* Perform Linux-based application administration and troubleshooting.
* Manage file systems, directories, permissions and application files.
* Analyze application and system logs.
* Execute SQL queries and perform basic database validation.
* Coordinate with Oracle/DBA and infrastructure teams for database-related issues.
* Perform application health checks and production validation.
* Handle P1/P2/P3 incidents and provide timely resolution.
* Follow Incident, Change and Problem Management processes.
* Prepare RCA, operational documentation and knowledge articles.
* Support application migration, upgrades and environment changes.
* Provide **24x7 production support** as part of a rotational schedule.

title: Infrastructure Services Talent Community - Linux Administrators to Principal Consultants
description:
### **Description**

We are continuing to grow our Infrastructure Services capability and are looking to connect with experienced infrastructure professionals interested in future opportunities with Forterro.

**We recruit across a range of levels, from hands-on Linux Administrators and Infrastructure Services Consultants through to experienced Principal Consultants.**

This is an evergreen opportunity rather than recruitment for one specific vacancy today. By joining our talent community, you can be considered for future Infrastructure Services opportunities that match your experience, technical expertise and career aspirations.

  

### **What you could be working on**

Our Infrastructure Services teams support business-critical ERP and enterprise application environments for customers, helping ensure their systems remain stable, secure and high performing.

Depending on your level and experience, your work could include:

* Administering and supporting Linux-based server environments
* Supporting ERP and other business-critical application infrastructure
* Working with virtualised and cloud-hosted environments
* Delivering system upgrades, patching, maintenance and migrations
* Monitoring and optimising system performance, capacity and reliability
* Diagnosing infrastructure issues and identifying root causes
* Supporting infrastructure modernisation and customer technology projects
* Managing networking, connectivity and secure remote-access requirements
* Working directly with customers on technical issues, maintenance and projects
* Collaborating across Consulting, Professional Services, Support and Development teams
* Sharing technical knowledge and mentoring colleagues
* At more senior levels, taking ownership of complex customer environments, leading technical activities and acting as a technical authority

  

### **Who we are looking for**

Our opportunities span **Linux Administrator, Infrastructure Services Consultant, Senior Consultant and Principal Consultant-level profiles**.

You might be a hands-on Linux Administrator looking to develop further into infrastructure services and consulting. Alternatively, you may already be an experienced customer-facing infrastructure professional or Principal Consultant who takes ownership of complex technical environments.

Rather than provide a long checklist of technologies, we want to understand **what you genuinely know and where your technical strengths lie**.

We are particularly interested in:

* The technologies and infrastructure environments you work with today
* Your experience administering Linux-based systems
* The enterprise applications or ERP environments you have supported
* Your experience with virtualisation, networking and cloud infrastructure
* The upgrades, migrations or infrastructure projects you have delivered
* The complexity and scale of the environments you have supported
* How you approach troubleshooting and root-cause analysis
* Your experience working directly with customers
* The level of technical ownership and responsibility you currently hold

You do not need experience with every technology used within Forterro. We are looking for strong infrastructure fundamentals, genuine technical capability and the ability to learn and adapt to new environments.

The scope of our roles varies according to experience.

As a **Linux Administrator or developing Infrastructure Services professional**, you might focus primarily on hands-on system administration, maintenance, monitoring, troubleshooting and supporting customer environments.

As an experienced **Infrastructure Services Consultant**, you may take greater ownership of customer environments, independently deliver upgrades and projects, resolve more complex technical problems and work directly with customers.

At **Senior and Principal Consultant level**, opportunities can involve taking ownership of complex environments, leading significant technical activities, acting as an escalation point, influencing technical decisions, mentoring colleagues and contributing to standards and best practices.

We consider technical depth, complexity of experience, autonomy, customer responsibility and leadership when determining which opportunity and level may be the best fit.

Technical capability is important, but so is how you apply it.

We are looking for people who can solve problems methodically, take ownership and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Fluent English is required. Additional language capabilities, including German, may be valuable for some opportunities.

### **Interested?**

If you are a **Linux Administrator, Infrastructure Services professional or experienced Principal Consultant**, we would like to hear from you.

Tell us about **the technologies you genuinely work with, the environments you have supported and the infrastructure problems you have solved**.

Join our Infrastructure Services talent community and, when a suitable opportunity becomes available, our Talent Acquisition team can contact you to explore whether there is a match.

### **About Forterro**

Founded in 2012, **Forterro** has grown to become a category leader in industrial software – with strongholds in Europe’s top production economies, as well as regional service hubs and development centres around the world. From more than 40 office locations, our 2,500+ employees provide and support software for more than 13,000 industrial businesses. **Our products** are deeply rooted in the demands of their local geography. And each is designed to strengthen and accelerate our customers’ ability to operate efficiently and compete effectively.
